notes.title: Lonely Mountains: Snow Riders hits the slopes on January 21st!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Riders! [/h2]

It’s finally time to buckle your boots. Lonely Mountains: Snow Riders, our ‘ski-quel’ to Lonely Mountains: Downhill, is coming to Steam and Xbox on January 21st! 

The game will feature 2-8 person crossplatform multiplayer with a competitive racing mode, as well as a cooperative team mode that’s perfect for hanging around with your friends on cold winter nights. Of course, it’s also fully playable in singleplayer, with lots of challenges and extensive leaderboards. If you’re just looking for some relaxed carving, the game also has a new ‘zen’ mode that lets you free-roam the mountains and place your own checkpoints. 

If you want to do some ski gymnastics and hone your skills before release, the Singleplayer demo is still online. And of course we would be super grateful if you could wishlist the game so we can climb the upcoming list on Steam! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3238120/Lonely_Mountains_Snow_Riders_Demo/

Thank you all for your patience and support! We’re all super excited to hit the slopes with all of you next week! 

Your Megagons

notes.title: Snow Riders multiplayer demo out now!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Riders[/h2]

A huge thanks to everyone who tried the teaser demo for Lonely Mountains: Snow Riders already! Your feedback is super helpful and it's good to see our speed-running community already doing the most crazy runs!😀

Today, we launched the full demo for Lonely Mountains: Snow Riders with a huge update that adds the following:
[list]
[*] 2-8 online multiplayer (racing)
[*] Added a whole new mountain track to explore (single and multiplayer)
[*] Improved physics. We took your feedback to heart and tweaked the physics a little bit. Initial pushing is now stronger, less air resistance at low speeds but stronger resistance at higher speeds and landing sidewards is more forgiving now.
[*] Due to the new balancing, we also cleared the leaderboards because previous records might not be achievable anymore. 
[*] Tons of fixes and improvements but most importantly
[*] - The infinite loading screen should be gone
[*] - The crash some people experienced when starting the game should now also be fixed
[/list]

You can download the demo on our demo Steam page right now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3238120/Lonely_Mountains_Snow_Riders_Demo/

This is the first time we are testing our online multiplayer, and we are super curios to hear if you like it! This time we are testing the racing mode for up to 8 people but the full version will also have a co-op mode. The team already had the best time testing the racing mode, as going on the slopes with a few friends adds a ton of fun and competitive chaos!

We are likely leaving the demo up for the whole duration of the Steam Fest (until the 21st October) but might remove it afterward again for a while to polish it up. So jump in while it lasts! 🙂

[previewyoutube=qwv3ImIALEA;full][/previewyoutube]

If you enjoy Lonely Mountains: Snow Riders, please add it to your wishlist or follow our developer account as that helps us a lot to make the game more visible on Steam. We would also be super grateful if you leave a review for the demo. 

All the best and have a great ride on the snowy Lonely Mountains!

Your Megagons

notes.title: Season 22 Postponed
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Riders,[/h1]

Unfortunately, we have to start today with some bad news. On Monday, after three and a half years our Playstation login server decided to draw its last electric breath. We’re working on bringing it back to life but at the moment we can’t say exactly how long it will take, but it might be up to two weeks. The good news is that there is no data loss, so everything should be back to normal when the problem is resolved. 

After some discussion, we decided to postpone today’s season start for all platforms as it wouldn’t be fair to our Playstation players if they can only join midseason. We are very sorry for the delay and we will let you know as soon as everything is up and running again. You can of course still play the non-season Daily Rides during the ongoing season break on all other platforms.

We hope for your understanding and thank you all for your patience!

Your Megagons

notes.title: Daily Rides Season 16 - Cirque du vélo
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Riders,[/h1]

Welcome back to Season 16 of our Daily Rides! We hope you’re all doing well. This season the circus is coming to town so please stand up and give warm applause to our Cirque du vélo!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30570088/9a896ec38b7540bc1559b3cb752aee247835bb0e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30570088/fb8485a1869128a8598006645498a22889a8fb92.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30570088/a30dbfd9193e7f8d2ce0161ea8aee7ecdcfd392c.jpg[/img]

This season not only comes with a whole bunch of stunning circus outfits and accessories, but we also introduce some changes to the Daily Ride structure. From now on Daily Rides will follow a weekly plan, so that each day a specific modifier or mode will always be active.

The plan goes as follows:

[list]
[*] Mirrored Monday - Mirror modifier will be active.
[*] Night-Time Tuesday - Night mode will be active.
[*] Winning Wednesday - Score Multiplier modifier will be active (and only on this day)
[*] Freeride Thursday - Freeride will always be active.
[*] Fast Friday - Unlimited Sprinting modifier will be active.
[*] Reckless Saturday - No Penalty modifier will be active.
[*] Super Sunday - Super Bike modifier will be active.
[/list]

These fixed modifiers (except the Score Multiplier) can be combined with other random modifiers, so they can still appear more than once. As an example, there could still be an active Super Bike and Mirror modifier on Fast Friday. 

From now on our DLC trails from Eldfjall Island, Riley’s Return, and Misty Peak will also be a part of the normal trail selection. This way they will be part of the Daily Rides way more often than they have been in the past. You don’t need to own the DLCs to play them in the Daily Rides - but of course, owning them helps with training for the Daily Rides ;)

As always the season will run for one month and will end on the 14th of September. Please let us know what you think of the new season and the daily ride changes in our [url=https://discord.gg/lonelymountains]Discord.[/url]

We wish you a great ride and a happy new season!

Your Megagons

notes.title: End of Season 10 "Riding Reindeer" & New Season Break Feature
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Riders,[/h1]

We hope you’re all doing well! Season 10 “Riding Reindeer” has ended today. We hope you had some good Daily Rides and congratulations to all participants and a round of some extra applause for the top 25!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30570088/653ed7d17337352857b76e565db1697dbaab54e7.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30570088/251687bfe610895710333aa3d2542b26685ceb74.jpg[/img]

From now on there will be a one-week season break between seasons so that everyone can catch their breath for a moment. During that time you can still ride the daily rides and there will also be daily leaderboards but there will be no season ranking and no rewards. 

A lot of riders also wished for shorter seasons so from now on upcoming seasons will only run for four weeks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30570088/bcb9f34241993626d6acce54e7d2e458f5ac1757.jpg[/img]
In other news: We’re very honored to be a part of this amazing Games Made in Germany feature. There are a lot of games in here made by friends of us and you should check it out if you have a moment. There are some real gems in here and definitely worth your time. 

https://store.steampowered.com/sale/games_germany

Have a great ride and all the best from Berlin and Gothenburg!

Your Megagons!

notes.title: Major Update - Daily Ride Modifiers introduced with season 7: Summer Strolls
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Riders[/h1]

Lots of new things going on this season. We have just released a major update to the game which introduces modifiers to the Daily Rides! We start today with the “Changed Checkpoints” modifier which changes and adds new checkpoints to the trail. notes.title: Join the open beta for our new feature - Daily Rides!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello lovely Riders![/h1]

We hope you’re all doing well![b] We are happy to announce that we’re working on new feature for the game: 

Daily Rides![/b]

Each day you are challenged to ride one of our trails with a preselected bike - facing some new obstacles on the way down. This requires you to leave old habits and your familiar route behind, when trying to get today's best time for that trail. But be aware: every crash is added as a penalty time to your total time! We wish you a lot of fun with the new daily rides!

See you on the leaderboards and much love from Berlin!
Jan, Noah & Daniel

notes.title: Lonely Mountains: Downhill Now Available on Nintendo Switch™
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Riders![/h1]

We hope you’re all safe and sound. We have great news for you! A lot of you asked for it and now it’s finally happening: [b]Lonely Mountains: Downhill launches on Nintendo Switch today! [/b]

[previewyoutube=MXsZEuKIXIU;full][/previewyoutube]

So if you’re looking for riding the Lonely Mountains on the go - here is your chance. The Switch version has the full feature set and its own leaderboards but unfortunately we had to reduce the graphics a little bit so it mostly runs with the medium PC settings but lower shadows and resolution. 

To ensure smooth gameplay we had to make some cutbacks on graphics side for the Switch version (comparable with medium terrain quality & low shadow settings on PC), however the game includes the full feature set and its own leaderboards!

We’re really happy as this means that the game we started to develop 5 years ago is now finally available on all major platforms - something we never thought possible when we started the development. Our biggest thanks go to our publishing partner [url=https://www.thunderfulgames.com/]Thunderful[/url] for coming with us on this ride and to [url=https://retroid.com/]Retroid Interactive[/url] - who once again did an amazing job on the Switch version!

[h2]German Video Game Awards[/h2]

There is another reason to celebrate as the game won the [b]“Best Innovation & Technology”[/b] award at the German Video Game Awards last week. There were so many good games nominated that we feel really honored that we were able to bring the trophy home. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30570088/220e464783412efbdeb96b1534305320ad0d58ce.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Feature Upcoming![/h2]
We’re busy working on a new big feature update for the game and we hope that we can share it with you soon! If you don’t want to wait then drop by in our Discord channel to access our brand new beta branch on Steam!

We wish you all a great ride - on whichever platform you play!

[b]Jan, Noah & Daniel![/b]

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 released!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Riders![/h1]

We just released version 1.0.4 and this updates brings quite a lot of changes to the game. Let us briefly walk you through the major ones. 

[u][b]New Bike Part System:[/b][/u] Nearly every review we read over the past 4 months criticized that it takes too long to unlock new bikes and from what we gathered most of the community seemed to agree with that. So we changed the system that bike parts are not bound to a specific bike anymore. Instead each bike costs a certain amount of parts and you can freely decide in what order you want to unlock them. 

[b]IMPORTANT: This means that if you start the game now you won’t have any other bikes  unlocked anymore but you will have all the parts you already collected. You can use these parts to repurchase your bikes (or even different ones) in the bike selection![/b]

[u][b]Easier Progression System:[/b][/u] Until this moment you needed to overcome every challenge in a category in order to unlock the next one. We know that this system blocked a lot of content for some players. Therefore from now on the free ride category of a trail gets also unlocked after finishing the beginner category. The challenges stay the same , so nothing gets easier per se but it allows players to try the free ride mode without having to do all the bike challenges first. 

[u][b]Balancing Changes:[/b][/u] We also made some smaller changes concerning the difficulty of some challenges. You can see the full list down below. 

[b]CHANGE LOG 1.0.4[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]New Part System: [/b]Parts can now be freely spent on any bike. [b]ATTENTION: You need to repurchase your bikes with your already collected parts![/b]
[b][*] Challenge System Changes: [/b]All challenges in all categories are now available after crossing the finish line. 
[*] [b]Bike Icons and Finish Line display:[/b] Each bike is now represented by an its own icon and you can see with which bike you already finished a trail. 
[*] [b]Daily/Weekly/Monthly Best-Time Display:[/b] If you cross the finish line you will now see if you achieved a daily, weekly or monthly best-time.  
[*] [b]Customization:[/b] The customization menu is now also available from the bike selection.
[*] Fixed missing checkpoint on Mount Riley/Trail 3 map.  
[*] Fixed "rider surfing in midair on resting spot" bug.
[*] Fixed "locked bike" problem although no bike challenges was selected.
[*]Improved water shader with moon and bike light reflections
[*]Several smaller bugfixes and performance optimizations.
[u][b][*]Balancing Changes: Several smaller balancing changes:[/b][/u][list] [*] [u][b]Graterhorn/Trail 02:[/b][/u]
[*] Increased time for Easy Trail challenge from 180 to 190 seconds.
[*] Increased time for Hard Paint Job 1 Challenge from 135 to 145 seconds
[*] Increased time for Hard Bike Part Challenge from 115 to 125 seconds
[*] Increased time for Hard Paint Job Challenge 2 from 125 to 135 seconds
[*][u][b]Graterhorn/Trail 04:[/b][/u]
[*]Increased time for Hard Outfit Challenge from 85 to 90 seconds
[*]Increased time for Hard Paint Job Challenge from 95 to 100 seconds
[*]Decreased crash amount for Night Easy Challenge to 18
[*][u][b]Redmoor Peaks/Trail 01:[/b][/u]
[*]Increased time for Easy Bike Part Challenge from 200 to 210 seconds
[*][u][b]Redmoor Peaks/Trail 04[/b][/u]
[*]Increased crash amount for Night Easy Challenge from 9 to 21
[*][u][b]Sierra Rivera/Trail 01:[/b][/u]
[*]Switched time and crash goals for Easy Outfit and Trail challenge
[*][u][b]Sierra Rivera/Trail 02:[/b][/u]
[*]Switched time and crash goals for Easy Bike Part and Trail challenge
[*][u][b]Mount Riley/Trail 01:[/b][/u]
[*]Switched time and crash goals for Easy Bike Part and Trail challenge
[*]Fixed bug that freeride challenge was a time challenge and not just a finish line challenge
[/list]
[/list]
We’re looking forward to your feedback to the new changes. In case you have any questions or want to discuss the changes with the community feel free to hit us up on the official Discord Server: https://discord.gg/lonelymountains

Have a great ride!

Jan & Daniel & Noah

PS: In case you’re reading this but you’re playing on a different platform than Steam please be aware that updates for consoles will from now on follow a week or two after the Steam update due to the longer submission process.
